# pamflow <a href="https://pradeeshwarrj.github.io/pamflow/"><img src="man/figures/logo.png" alt="pamflow website" align="right" height="139"/></a>

**End-to-end Passive Acoustic Monitoring workflow**

`pamflow` takes you from raw field recordings to ecological useful information — with a single config file and a handful of function calls.

`Workflow A (Species Detection & Occupancy)`: Run BirdNET, clean & merge detections, perform stratified validation with Shiny, build daily site occupancy matrices, and compile executive reports.

`Workflow B (Soundscape Analysis)`: Compute core acoustic indices (ACI, ADI, AEve, Bio, H, M, NDSI) following Bradfer-Lawrence et al. (2019) with 500 Hz low-stop filtering, 1-minute memory-safe sub-chunking, 24-hour diel profiles, and automated HTML diagnostic reports.

## Features

- **Raven Compass-style Standardization & Triage** for raw multi-recorder workflow (SongMeter, AudioMoth, SwiftOne)
- **Scan & QC** thousands of WAV files automatically
- **Batch BirdNET detection** with parallel workers and resume support
- **Clean & merge** overlapping detections into events
- **Interactive validation** via Shiny app with precision metrics
- **Occupancy detection histories** (daily 1/0 matrices per site per species)
- **Ecoacoustic Soundscape Indices** Dynamic computation of ACI, ADI, AEve, Bio, H, M, and NDSI.
- **Soundscape Visualizations & HTML Reports** 24-hour diel profiles, Day vs. Night comparisons, sitecovariate tables, and standalone HTML reports.

## Prerequisites

| Software | Version | Notes                       |
|----------|---------|-----------------------------|
| R        | ≥ 4.3   | 64-bit                      |
| Python   | ≥ 3.9   | Required by BirdNET         |
| FFmpeg   | any     | Required for audio clipping |
| birdnetR | latest  | BirdNET model wrapper       |

Verify in R:

``` r
R.version.string           # ≥ 4.3
reticulate::py_available() # TRUE
system("ffmpeg -version")  # prints version
```

## Installation

``` r
# Install devtools if needed
install.packages("devtools")

# Install birdnetR
devtools::install_github("birdnet-team/birdnetR")

# Install pamflow
devtools::install_github("pradeeshwarrj/pamflow")
```

## Quick Start

### 1. Set up your project folder

```         
MyProject/
├── data/
│   └── raw/                # Original recorder dumps (untouched)
│       ├── SongMeter/
│       ├── AudioMoth/
│       └── SwiftOne/
├── audio/                  # Standardized WAV/FLAC (created by Stage 00)
│   ├── GXXXX/
│   └── GXXXX/
├── metadata/
│   └── deployments.csv     # one row per deployment
├── config/
│   └── config.yml          # pipeline settings
└── ground_truth/           # optional, for recall estimation
```

### 2. Create `metadata/deployments.csv`

``` csv
| grid  | recorder | deployment_id | start_datetime   | end_datetime     |
|-------|----------|---------------|------------------|------------------|
| G0059 | SW010    | 13            | 05-04-2026 18:30 | 08-04-2026 16:00 |
| G0110 | SW012    | 7             | 01-04-2026 06:00 | 10-04-2026 18:00 |
```

### 3. Create `config/config.yml`

``` yaml
project_name: "My PAM Project"
run_id: "run01"

paths:
  project_root: "E:/MyProject"
  raw: "data/raw"
  audio: "audio"
  metadata: "metadata"
  deployments_file: "deployments.csv"
  detections: "data/detections"
  logs: "logs"
  reports: "reports"

standardization:
  min_duration_s: 60
  timezone: "Asia/Kolkata"
  pattern: "^(?<grid>G\\d{4})_(?<date>\\d{8})_(?<time>\\d{6})(_chunk\\d+)?\\.(flac|wav)$"
  output_format: "flac"

birdnet:
  model: "BirdNET_GLOBAL_6K_V2.4_Model_FP32.tflite"
  labels: "BirdNet_v2_custom_Labels.txt"
  chunk_length_s: 3
  overlap_s: 0
  min_confidence: 0.5
  workers: 4

processing:
  input: "standardized"
  merge_gap_s: 3
  drop_outside_deployment: true
  min_confidence: 0.4

soundscape:
  enabled: true
  window_mins: 10
  low_stop_hz: 500
  acoustic_indices:
    ACI:
    ADI:
      fmin: 0
      fmax: 24000
      bin_step: 1000
    AEve:
    Bio:
      flim: [2000, 11000]
    H:
    M:
    NDSI:
      anthro_range: [1000, 2000]
      bio_range: [2000, 11000]
  day_hours: [6, 17]
  night_hours: [18, 5]

occupancy:
  occasion_length_days: 1
  min_effort_hours: 2
  min_detections: 5
  timezone: "Asia/Kolkata"

report:
  title: "PAM Report"
  format: "html"
```

### 4. Run the pipeline

Stage 00: Standardization & Data Triage (Raven Compass)

Raw multi-recorder dumps are often messy (mixed formats, voice memos, field notes, inconsistent filenames). Stage 00 standardizes them without modifying original raw files.

### Interactive Shiny App

``` r
library(pamflow)
pam_standardization_app()
```

The GUI provides three tabs:

- [Inspect] — Preview files, extract metadata, test filename regex

- [Convert] — Batch convert and organize into standardized folders

- [Log] — Live processing log

### Headless Standardization R

``` r
library(pamflow)
cfg <- pam_config_read("E:/MyProject/config/config.yml")

pam_standardize(
  raw_dir = "E:/MyProject/data/raw",
  out_dir = "E:/MyProject/audio",
  config  = cfg
)
```

#### What Stage 00 does:

- Extracts grid IDs and timestamps from SongMeter, AudioMoth, and SwiftOne filenames

- Isolates voice memos (\< 60 s), text logs, and unreadable files into isolated/

- Converts and renames audio into a uniform structure under audio/G####/

- Leaves all original raw files untouched

## Workflow A: Detection & Occupancy Pipeline

``` r
library(pamflow)
cfg <- pam_config_read("E:/MyProject/config/config.yaml")

# Stage 00: Standardize raw recorder dumps (if not done via Shiny app)
pam_standardize(
  raw_dir = file.path(cfg$paths$project_root, cfg$paths$raw),
  out_dir = file.path(cfg$paths$project_root, cfg$paths$audio),
  config  = cfg
)

# Stage 1: Scan audio and check deployments
pam_scan_audio(cfg)

# Stage 3: Run BirdNET detection (parallel, resumable)
pam_detect(cfg)

# Stage 4: Clean, filter, and merge detections
pam_process_detections(cfg)

# Stage 5: Validate a sample of detections
pam_validation_draw(cfg)
pam_validation_export(cfg)
pam_validation_app(cfg)          # opens Shiny app in browser

# After closing the app:
val  <- pam_validation_import(cfg)
pool <- pam_validation_pool(cfg)
pam_validation_metrics(val, pool, bands = c(0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9))

# Stage 6: Build occupancy detection histories
pam_build_occupancy(cfg)

# Stage 8: Generate species detection reports
pam_report(cfg)
```

## Workflow B: Soundscape Analysis Pipeline

``` r
library(pamflow)
cfg <- pam_config_read("E:/MyProject/config/config.yaml")

# Stage 00: Standardize raw recorder dumps
pam_standardize(
  raw_dir = file.path(cfg$paths$project_root, cfg$paths$raw),
  out_dir = file.path(cfg$paths$project_root, cfg$paths$audio),
  config  = cfg
)

# Stage 1: Scan audio and check deployments
pam_scan_audio(cfg)

# Stage 2b: Calculate soundscape indices (ACI, Bio, NDSI, etc.)
sc_results <- pam_soundscape_run(cfg)

# Stage 2c: Generate 24-hour diel plots, Day/Night comparisons & HTML Report
vis_results <- pam_soundscape_run_vis(cfg)
```

## Pipeline Stages

| Workflow | Stage | Function | What it does |
|------------------|------------------|------------------|-------------------|
| Both | 00 | `pam_standardize()/pam_standarization_app()` | Raven Compass-style triage: metadata extraction, memoisolation (\<60s), non-audio log separation, FLAC/WAV standardization |
| Both | 1 | `pam_scan_audio()` | Inventories audio files, matches to deployments, flags QC issues |
| Both | 2 | `pam_filter_audio()` | High-pass filter on the QC checked files; can be customized |
| B | 2b | `pam_soundscape_run()` | Computes soundscape indices per 10-min window with 500Hz high-pass filter |
| B | 2c | `pam_soundscape_run_vis()` | Plots 24-hour diel profiles, Day/Night comparisons, and generates HTML report |
| A | 3 | `pam_detect()` | Runs BirdNET on all files in parallel batches; resumable |
| A | 4 | `pam_process_detections()` | Filters by confidence, deployment window, species; merges overlapping windows |
| A | 5 | `pam_validation_draw()` | Draws a stratified random sample for manual review |
| A | 5 | `pam_validation_export()` | Cuts short WAV clips around each sampled detection |
| A | 5 | `pam_validation_app()` | Shiny app to listen and confirm/reject species |
| A | 5 | `pam_validation_metrics()` | Computes precision by species and confidence band |
| A | 6 | `pam_build_occupancy()` | Builds daily detection matrices, effort, and site covariates |
| A | 8 | `pam_report()` | Generates HTML report and Excel workbook |

> **Note:** All stage functions take `cfg` as their primary argument. The run_id is read from the config file. Stage 00 can also be run interactively via `pam_standardization_app()`.

## Configuration Reference

| Section | Key | Default | Description |
|------------------|------------------|------------------|-------------------|
| `standardization` | `min_duration_s` | 60 | Files shorter than this are isolated as memos |
| `standardization` | `timezone` | `"Asia/Kolkata"` | Timezone for filename datetime parsing |
| `standardization` | `output_format` | `"wav/flac"` | Output audio format (`flac` or `wav`) |
| `birdnet` | `workers` | 4 | Number of parallel CPU cores |
| `birdnet` | `min_confidence` | 0.5 | Minimum BirdNET score to keep |
| `birdnet` | `chunk_length_s` | 3 | Audio chunk length in seconds |
| `processing` | `input` | `"standardized"` | Use raw (`"standardized"`) or filtered audio |
| `processing` | `merge_gap_s` | 3 | Gap (seconds) for merging overlapping detections |
| `processing` | `drop_outside_deployment` | `true` | Remove detections outside deployment windows |
| `occupancy` | `occasion_length_days` | 1 | Days per sampling occasion |
| `occupancy` | `min_effort_hours` | 2 | Minimum recording hours per occasion |
| `occupancy` | `min_detections` | 5 | Minimum total detections to include a species |
| `occupancy` | `timezone` | `"Asia/Kolkata"` | Timezone for day boundaries |

## Resumability

If `pam_detect()` is interrupted (power loss, crash, etc.), simply run it again. It checks for completed batches and picks up where it left off.
